data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 泳池遮阳伞下纯白比基尼的典雅挺拔
data.description: 度假酒店澄澈泳池畔，绫濑身着素雅纯白荷叶边细带比基尼坐在遮阳伞下，乌黑长发如瀑垂落雪白肌肤，展现绝美名模身段。
data.location: 高级度假村遮阳伞休憩区
data.action: 坐在白色躺椅上微侧身躯，修长玉腿并拢，单手轻理被水沾湿的发梢，神情矜持而惹人心动
data.lighting: 水面跃动的波光在白皙大腿与锁骨上投射出晶莹光纹
data.camera: 中景低机位，完美呈现九头身比例与端庄气质
data.promptProse: Ayase Aragaki reclines gracefully on a cushioned white lounge chair beneath the canopy of a wide canvas parasol beside a luxury resort pool. Her pure-white ruffled string bikini emphasizes her slender model proportions and fair skin. Shimmering turquoise water reflections ripple across her thighs and collarbones as she combs her fingers through damp obsidian hair, smiling with reserved charm.
data.animaCaption: Resting in the dappled shade of a poolside cabana, Ayase adjusts her sleek black hair with modest, poised grace.
